//: Build config for the `manage` CLI. It compiles src/cli/** together with the src/server/** modules the CLI shares with the Next server (ruling O1). `paths` is emptied on purpose: tsc does not rewrite path aliases on emit, so an `@/…` import reachable from here would type-check and then fail at runtime inside the container. Emitting to dist/ keeps the relative layout the entrypoint needs.
